svg.title: Tech toolkit
svg.desc: Tech stack. Languages: Python, Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn, OpenCV. Frameworks: Flask, React.js, TensorFlow (basics). ML and AI: Machine Learning, NLP, Deep Learning (basics), Generative AI, LLMs, RAG. Tools: Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, VS Code, Git, GitHub, Android Studio, Power BI. Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Firebase Firestore. Other: Tesseract OCR, REST APIs, Data Visualization, EDA.
